article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article14Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part II—Suits Relating to Contracts
For the price of goods sold and delivered where no fixed period of credit is agreed upon.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of the delivery of the goods.
